title: Saving the checklist recomputed it from the current archive instead of the brief's dev commit
resolution: The text names its dev commit and --save needs --at, which ranks the archive as of that commit through git; unknown commits are refused.

title: A fixed cutoff date did not implement changes started after this change lands
resolution: Changes need checklist.json when their .openspec.yaml was first committed after the commit that archives this change, or is uncommitted.

title: Validation accepted impossible checklist records: counts above totals, duplicate or unranked categories, an invalid time
resolution: Added consistency checks for time, unique ranked categories within top, and baseline counts, each with a negative test.

title: Saving to the reserved archive name passed the active-change check
resolution: Only real active change directories other than archive are accepted; the refusal writes nothing.

title: The Makefile comment said validate takes --json
resolution: The comment now names only index, reviewers, and effect as taking --json.
